description: A repayment mortgage's payment at today's rate and at one, two and 3 points higher, what each leaves of take-home once the bills and other debts are paid, the rate at which it would stop fitting, and the payment once a fixed rate ends. Use for 'what if rates went up 3%', 'could we still afford the mortgage when the fix ends'.

fixEndsInMonths.description: Months until a fixed rate ends, if it is fixed.

monthlyIncome.description: Take-home pay a month, in pounds. Defaults to 0, which shows the payments alone.

otherOutgoings.description: Everything else that leaves take-home a month - bills and other debts' payments, not this mortgage. Defaults to 0.

rateAfterFixPct.description: The rate once the fix ends, usually the lender's standard variable rate.

stressPoints.description: The rise to test, in percentage points. Defaults to 3.

name: calculate_mortgage_stress_test
title: Mortgage stress test
